[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-16h[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]E1.5: enforced sase tool adoption and monitor wrapping[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every heavy verification run by a SASE agent is a recorded ToolRun [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]by construction: guarded recipes refuse a raw agent invocation, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]monitors wrap what they run, the wrapper is at least as faithful as[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the raw command, and the linked repos carry their own catalogs and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]guards.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]tool_e15_enforced_adoption.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make an agent an ownership root and always export the wrapper [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]marker[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]ownership-roots[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ownership-roots: scrub executor-ownership variables at every agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]launch, ignore an inherited monitor/proc id under SASE_AGENT, always [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]export SASE_TOOL_NAME and SASE_TOOL_PROJECT_ROOT, and carry a monitor's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]starter agent into its recorded runs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Record child process facts and authorize reaping in sase-core[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-child-facts[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ownership-roots[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-child-facts: add the sase-core wire, store write, and binding that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]persist a running run's child pid, pgid, and process identity, extend [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reconcile to return identity-matched reap candidates, and move sase's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]core revision pin past that commit.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make the wrapper as faithful as the raw command[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]wrapper-fidelity[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-child-facts[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]wrapper-fidelity: keep the child in the wrapper's process group under a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]live owner, make an inline child die with its wrapper, reap [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]identity-matched survivors of lost runs, and give the child one merged [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pipe whenever a single target receives both streams.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Refuse a raw agent invocation of a guarded recipe[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]recipe-guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]after wrapper-fidelity[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]recipe-guard: add the dependency-free tools/require_tool_run script, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]wire it into check and check-full, document the environment contract, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]teach the adoption report bypasses and refusals, and record the decision[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that partly supersedes record-before-admit.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Wrap a monitor's command in sase tool run[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]monitor-wrap[dim] · [dim][/dim]after recipe-guard[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor-wrap: upgrade an exact catalog match to a named run and wrap [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]other verify-profile commands ad-hoc, in the proc argv only, behind a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor.tool_wrap config field, leaving monitor_command and host [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]completion bindings untouched.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Give the linked repos catalogs and guards[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]linked-repo-catalogs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after monitor-wrap[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]linked-repo-catalogs: add project tools catalogs and the recipe guard to[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-core, sase-telegram, sase-github, and sase-research-artifacts so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]enforcement and named upgrades reach the raw residual that lives outside[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the sase repo.[/#D7D7AF]
